slots.label: Introduction
slots.text: These terms cover your use of the Fit Health Distributing website. By using the site or sending us a request, you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not use the site.
slots.hint: Starting wording, not legal advice. Have it reviewed before launch.

slots.label: Text
slots.text:
Nothing on this site is an offer to sell, and sending a request does not place an order. A request asks us for a quote. It does not commit you to buy or us to supply.

Prices, delivery, installation and any other terms of a sale are set out in the written quote we send you. An agreement is made only when you accept that quote.

We work to keep descriptions, photos, specifications, prices and stock levels accurate, but they can change and may contain mistakes. Prices on the site are a guide until we confirm them in a quote.

We describe supplements and drinks by what they contain. Nothing on this site is medical advice.

slots.label: Introduction
slots.text: This policy explains what Fit Health Distributing collects through this website, why we collect it, and the choices you have.
slots.hint: Starting wording, not legal advice. Have it reviewed before launch.

slots.label: Text
slots.text:
When you send a request we receive your name, your email address and what you are interested in, plus anything else you choose to give us: your company, phone number, message and the products you picked. We also record that you agreed to our terms and whether you asked for marketing emails, with the time and the wording you saw. We also note how you found the site: the website that sent you here, if any, the tags in the link you followed, such as the campaign or ad it came from, and the first page you opened.

To block spam we keep a scrambled code made from your internet address, not the address itself, and use it only to stop repeated requests.
slots.hint: Starting wording, not legal advice. Have it reviewed before launch. Leave a heading and its text empty to drop that part.

slots.label: Text
slots.text:
We use your details to answer your request: to prepare a quote, to reply to you, and to keep a record of what you asked for.

If you tick the box for marketing emails, we may also email you about our products and offers. We do not send them otherwise. You can stop them at any time by replying to one of them or by contacting us.
slots.hint: Starting wording, not legal advice. Have it reviewed before launch. Leave a heading and its text empty to drop that part.

slots.label: Text
slots.text:
Your details go to our team and nowhere else. We do not sell them, and we do not share them with advertisers.

Service providers run the site for us and handle data only on our behalf. Vercel hosts the website and, like any web host, keeps short-lived technical logs of visits, including internet addresses, to run and protect it. Supabase stores our database in the United States.
slots.hint: Starting wording, not legal advice. Have it reviewed before launch. Leave a heading and its text empty to drop that part.

slots.label: Text
slots.text: This site does not use advertising or tracking cookies. The products you pick are kept in your own browser, not on our servers, so they are still there when you come back. Sending your request clears them. How you found the site is kept in your browser too, only until you close the tab, and reaches us only with a request.
slots.hint: Starting wording, not legal advice. Have it reviewed before launch. Leave a heading and its text empty to drop that part.

slots.label: Text

slots.hint: Starting wording, not legal advice. Have it reviewed before launch. Leave a heading and its text empty to drop that part.
